p: Dundas Arcade sits in the middle of Middlesbrough's shopping streets, just off Linthorpe Road, so this daytime Admiral is aimed squarely at people already in town. Adult gaming centre rules apply: over 18s only.

There's more to the town than shops. Middlesbrough's big landmark is the Transporter Bridge over the Tees, a huge blue steel structure that carries a gondola across the river. mima, the Middlesbrough Institute of Modern Art, is on Centre Square in the town centre, and Albert Park is a fine Victorian park for a wander. Captain Cook was born in Marton on the edge of town, and the Captain Cook Birthplace Museum in Stewart Park tells his story. Football fans will head for the Riverside Stadium on matchdays.
